findings.description: In the Llama 3-to-Mistral NeMo 12B transplant, Method M with k=64 outperformed FOCUS, ZeroEmbed, and MeanEmbed on all six accuracy benchmarks and achieved lower WikiText bits per byte.

Despite leading the alternative initializations in the Mistral NeMo setting, Method M with k=64 remained below the original-tokenizer model on every reported metric, with an especially large GSM8K loss.
Increasing Method M's anchor count from k=8 to k=64 improved MMLU, ARC-C, GSM8K, AGIEval, and WikiText, but produced tiny decreases on XNLI and Lambada.
In the Qwen 2.5-to-Llama 3 1B transplant, Method M outperformed all four published zero-shot methods on MMLU, ARC-C, Belebele, and WikiText, although FOCUS scored higher on GSM8K.

Against the simple initializations in the Llama 3 1B setting, Method M tied ZeroEmbed on MMLU, ARC-C, and GSM8K, was 0.0001 below MeanEmbed on MMLU while tying it on ARC-C and GSM8K, and performed better than both on Belebele and WikiText.
Relative to the original Llama 3 1B model, Method M preserved ARC-C exactly and nearly preserved MMLU, but performed worse on GSM8K, Belebele, and WikiText.

The comparisons are descriptive because no statistical tests were reported; additionally, T1 reports a single evaluation per model, and standard errors are unavailable for T1 WikiText and T2 Belebele and WikiText.

numeric_facts.description: Method M's MMLU accuracy in the Mistral NeMo transplant was 0.6222.
Method M exceeded the better simple initializer on MMLU in the Mistral NeMo transplant by 0.0286.
Method M reduced WikiText bits per byte by 0.1576 relative to the better simple initializer in the Mistral NeMo transplant.
Method M's GSM8K accuracy was 0.4125 below the original Mistral NeMo model.
Method M's MMLU accuracy was 0.0033 below the original Llama 3 1B model.
Method M exactly matched the original Llama 3 1B model on ARC-C.
Method M's GSM8K accuracy was 0.0531 below the original Llama 3 1B model.
Method M exceeded the best published zero-shot method's MMLU accuracy in the Llama 3 1B transplant by 0.0945.
